items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I got a letter he wrote home, man, to me.

ctx.x: You know that's something I ain't never want? There's two things I was promised. I always promised a typewriter and one of them things. And I don't know nothing about either one of them. I never said what Joe Glazer told Louie. Louie bought one of them, he was that one finger. My sister. Yeah. One, there you go. Joe said, that one damn finger gets you in trouble. That was one finger dead, man.
I got a letter he wrote home, man, to me.
